Hi Jordan — thanks for the submission and context. Quick checklist from marketplace listings: 

- Offering type: SaaS (good). Please ensure you select "SaaS with metering" if you plan to bill per-token or per-instance.
- Required assets: 3 screenshots (1200x800), logo (512x512 PNG), short offering summary (<=600 chars), long description (<=4000 chars), EULA or link to terms. Your package-assets zip should include all of these.
- Compliance flags: include SOC 2 and KMS info in the security section. If you don't have SOC 2, include a statement of planned timeline and compensating controls (AWS may require additional review).
- Copy guidance: avoid promotional language like "best-in-class" or comparative claims. Focus on capabilities and measurable outcomes.

We can do a formal intake review once you upload the draft to the Seller Console. For the co-sell program, you'll want to add the co-sell tag and then coordinate with your partner manager (Sonia) to enable the listing for co-sell.

I should be able to provide a more detailed asset checklist if you upload the draft by EOD Wed.

Best,
AWS Marketplace Listings Team
